title: Revised Extension of Corporation Tax Filing Deadline and Update on Monthly Prepayments
text:
GUIDANCE NOTE
Reference OGC No. 2/2025
Revised Extension of Corporation Tax Filing Deadline and Update on
Title
Monthly Prepayments
Guidance on the Revised Extended Filing Deadline for Returns for Income
Subtitle
Year 2024 and Updated Submission Method for Monthly Prepayments
To provide updated information on the revised deadline for filing
Purpose Corporation Tax returns and the updated submission method for monthly
tax prepayments.
Revised Extended Deadline for Filing Corporation Tax Returns and Monthly
Prepayments – Updated Submission Method
The Barbados Revenue Authority (the "Authority") announces the following updates:
1. Revised Deadline for March 2025 Filings1: In light of ongoing internal technical
challenges, the Authority advises that the deadline for filing Corporation Tax
returns originally due in March 2025 has been further revised to June 16, 2025.
This extension is intended to ensure all taxpayers are afforded sufficient time to
meet their filing obligations while the Authority continues to address system-
related issues.
The deadlines for filing returns for Corporation Tax for the Income Year 2024 are
as follows:
Fiscal Period Ending Filing Deadline
1st January to 30th September June 16, 2025 (per Ministerial extension)
1st October to 31st December June 15, 2025 (June 16, 2025, since June 15 is a
Sunday)
2. Monthly Prepayments—Updated Submission Method: Corporation tax monthly
prepayments must continue to be paid no later than the 15th day of each calendar
month through the Global Relations Portal (https://globalrelations.bra.gov.bb).
This process shall remain in effect until further notice and replaces the previous
instructions regarding submitting monthly prepayments through the Tax
Administration Management Information System (TAMIS), in the guidance titled
"Monthly Tax Prepayments for Income Year 2025 – OGC No. 04/20252".
We appreciate your cooperation and understanding as we continue to enhance the
Authority’s systems and service delivery.
For any questions or further clarification regarding this guidance, please contact the
Contact Centre at 1(246) 429-ETAX or 429-3829.
Office of the General Counsel, Policy
Barbados Revenue Authority
